limits: Heights describe the building stock around 2018, before the war; they are not damage results.
GHSL heights are 100 m grid means: a tall building among low ones is underestimated.
31% of buildings have a GHSL value at the 2.5 m floor (not resolved); those get 3-7 m.

First check (14 Nov 2026) on 414 OSM-tagged buildings: GHSL within 3 m for 39%, range holds the tagged height for 51%; good for 1-2 storeys (78%), poor above (22-32%), towers about 11 m too low. These ranges are not final: U-03 calibrates them (docs/progress/BUILDING_HEIGHT_CHECK.md).
